notes.title: [WILD WEST: THE LAST COWBOY] Balance Patch Progress News
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow gunslingers!

This is the "The Wild West" development team.



Today, we're updating you on the latest balance patch progress.



We're working on a balance patch to ensure each character's unique charm and fighting style shines even more on the battlefield.

This patch goes beyond simple numerical adjustments; we've thoroughly analyzed each character's strengths and weaknesses through internal test footage and developer match simulations.


[hr][/hr]
🔥 Maxwell's cool-headed command of the battlefield

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/690204867756eba575c5792a5e8c3be7aee7b958.gif"]
[hr][/hr]
⚡ Jane's unexpected speed that cuts through the wind

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/69182de8794d38d2aaa5d93a12e8f231aad0e884.gif"]
[hr][/hr]
💥 Howard's tenacious vitality, a powerful blow that blocks enemy attacks

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/f1dd28727ca106e0eec50ade080043351c8fdee9.gif"]
[hr][/hr]
🌌 Jack's agile counterattack that seeps in like a shadow

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583054/76eaf4ae98a28a79ea42aac030e59e16380f075e.gif"]
[hr][/hr]
As such, we're doing our best to create a balanced battlefield environment where each character's unique personality lives and breathes.



🔧Main Progression

Developers personally select characters and test them in various ways, including 1v1 and team battles.

Gameplay is recorded on video to analyze each character's strengths, weaknesses, and utilization.

If a particular character is too strong or too weak, their stats and skills are fine-tuned.



Our goal is to ensure that all players can enjoy fair yet unique combat, regardless of their character choice.

We'll be releasing internal test footage along with more specific patch notes soon, so please look forward to it! 🎥



We look forward to your interest and feedback on our quest to create a fairer and more realistic Western battlefield.

Your legend begins now.

Thank you.

notes.title: Wild West: The Last Cowboy New Update!
notes.notes:
Howdy, gunmen!

"The Wild West" development team 😁



I've brought you a new update!



Strengthen Rank AI Matching & Custom Team Features!

In this update, we have improved matching of rank battles and even further upgraded team features in custom mode. Strategic play is easier, and the wait is less! ⚔️



🎯 Automatic AI matching in case of rank match failure!

Now, if rank matching fails, it automatically matches with AI after a certain period of time and can start playing immediately.

If you're tired of waiting to match, don't miss practice or score anymore!



👥 Custom Mode – Team Change Added!

You can freely move to the team you want in the waiting room.

It's more fun to strategically form a team or play in a team like a friend.



🎨 Improvement of UI for displaying the waiting room team

The player list shows the team color and name, so you can see at a glance who is which team.

It's especially useful in a mode where team play is important!



👁 Extension of viewing mode (2:2/3:3 mode included)

Now you can watch it in 2:2/3:3 mode!

Even if you don't play it yourself, you can watch your friends' games.



🛠 Fix bugs

I corrected the phenomenon that the UI went wrong when the mode selection button was pressed when creating a custom room.

Stabilized the UI to no longer twist with button clicks.



We will continue to improve our playing environment in the future.

Opinions are always welcome! 💬

notes.title: Wild West: The Last Cowboy update news!
notes.notes:
Howdy, gunmen!



"The Wild West" development team 😁





Here's the news of the new update!





📢 Add spectator mode and finish trimming



"Now I enjoy my friend's play, too!" 👀





👓 Add viewer mode



Custom Mode Exclusive Spectator Feature Added!



You can watch your friend's game without having to participate in the battle yourself.





👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Up to 4 people can enter 1:1 mode



It has been changed so that up to four people, including spectators, can enjoy it together.





🧼 UI & Effect Improvement



Improvement of death production



Now, when the player dies, it turns into a ghost hand, and you can see at a glance whether it survives or not.





🎯 Feel free to share what you felt while playing.



If you can share your own wonderful moments, our development team will be a great help, too!

notes.title: Wild West: The Last Cowboy Update Announcement!
notes.notes:
Howdy, gunmen!



"The Wild West" development team 🤠





Today, I brought additional updates.





📢 A wider battle with new modes and battlefields!



"No more 1:1 team play with friends!" 👊





⚔️ New mode: 2:2 & 3:3 Team match



Now you can team up with a friend and fight 2:2, 3:3 together.



All team modes are supported in Custom mode, Rank Battle!

Custom Mode Panel Front-Reveal



The existing personal screen is now shown to everyone like a bulletin board.





🛠 Fix bugs



Resolve missing grade bonus score error



Correcting the status quo where you were shot



Remove any bugs that could have been captured after death





🎯 Feel free to share what you felt while playing.



If you can share your own wonderful moments, our development team will be a great help, too!

notes.title: Wild West: The Last Cowboy Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Howdy, Gunslingers!
This is the Wild West Development Team 🤠

We’ve got some exciting updates for you today!

🎯 Russian Roulette Mode
We’ve been working intensively on this brand-new mode for over a month!
An extreme PvP mode where mind games and luck collide is finally here.

🎓 Tutorial Improvements
We’ve added guide animations to help new players get started more smoothly.
The tutorial is now more detailed, helping players naturally learn how to shoot and understand the game flow.
In particular, we’ve added a duel section against NPCs so you can build up your real combat instincts.

🗺️ Map Structure Improvements
We’ve fine-tuned the lighting colors and restructured object placements.
The environment now feels more authentic to the Wild West and much more lively, with clearer movement paths.

🕹️ VR Movement Enhancements
We’ve refined player movement synchronization in VR,
making actions look much more natural to other players.
